video_title: 專訪Amen Thompson，他恐怖的運動能力從何而來？如何區分Amen Thompson和Ausar Thompson？Kevin Durant是個什麼樣的人？【Telfair的球員專訪】

quotes.speaker: Amen Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson on his twin brother Ausar Thompson and Reed Sheppard
quotes.excerpt: This time I don't have my twin with me but I got Reed who's basically a new twin.

text_blocks.speaker: Telfair
text_blocks.text: Do you come here by yourself?

text_blocks.speaker: Amen Thompson
text_blocks.text: This time I don't have my twin with me but I got Reed who's basically a new twin. My Kentucky twin. I like that, thank you, because I was going to say something else.

quotes.speaker: Amen Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson on how to distinguish him from Ausar Thompson
quotes.excerpt: He got the braids now. You're not going to see me with braids too often.

text_blocks.speaker: Amen Thompson
text_blocks.text: First thing I'll say is I'm better looking, but beauty is in the eye of the beholder. He got the braids now. You're not going to see me with braids too often. I don't do weird things, he does. That's my trick, man. He does weird things.

quotes.speaker: Amen Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson on his most intense one-on-one battle with Ausar Thompson
quotes.excerpt: He was beating me in one-on-ones and I wouldn't leave the court unless I won.

text_blocks.speaker: Telfair
text_blocks.text: What about the craziest fight you ever had in a driveway, park, or the backyard?

text_blocks.speaker: Amen Thompson
text_blocks.text: He was beating me in one-on-ones and I wouldn't leave the court unless I won. He stopped trying and I could tell when he stopped trying, so I'm like, I'm not going to leave unless you try and I beat you. He didn't want to keep playing at me, so I hit him. I regret it. We've made up obviously, I love that guy, but it's a fun story.

quotes.speaker: Amen Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson on how OTE helped his development as an NBA prospect
quotes.excerpt: They told me I could really be a great and knowing that they've seen it before.

text_blocks.speaker: Telfair
text_blocks.text: How did OTE help you to become an NBA player?

text_blocks.speaker: Amen Thompson
text_blocks.text: They had great facilities. It just had people who believed in me, people who I had never seen. I don't know what it meant to be an NBA prospect. I never been around professionals before. That was the first time I was around professionals, and they told me I could really be a great and knowing that they've seen it before, they've been there before, it made it easy for me to strive even harder to be great.

quotes.speaker: Amen Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson on his 'Welcome to the NBA' moment against DeMar DeRozan
quotes.excerpt: I never had a good defensive game against DeMar yet. That was really my welcome to the NBA.

text_blocks.speaker: Telfair
text_blocks.text: Who is the first person who bust your ass?

text_blocks.speaker: Amen Thompson
text_blocks.text: I never had a good defensive game against DeMar yet. That was really my welcome to the NBA moment because I took pride in my defense. They told me don't buy into his pump fake, and I was like, I'm not going to buy into his pump fake. Everybody's telling me not to buy into his pump fake. First pump fake, I jump. So I had to, well Fred, I was supposed to give him $100, I haven't. He was lenient on that. He knew I was going to jump.

quotes.speaker: Amen Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson on Kevin Durant's greatness on and off the court
quotes.excerpt: Nothing can stop him from going in. You're amazed watching his greatness.

text_blocks.speaker: Telfair
text_blocks.text: Do you have best KD story who shows how KD is on the court and off the court?

text_blocks.speaker: Amen Thompson
text_blocks.text: I feel like they should have a camera at the bench when KD hits certain shots. It just feels like when he's shooting certain shots, nothing can stop him from going in. The other day somebody their hand was over the ball and he shot it and it doesn't touch anything. If somebody could film the bench reaction, it would be the funniest thing. You're amazed watching his greatness. But off the court, he's just a normal guy, a ball player. He don't want to be caught up in that. He wants you to think of him as a normal person.

quotes.speaker: Amen Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Amen Thompson on his favorite block in his NBA career
quotes.excerpt: I block Curry badly once in In-Season Tournament. That was a good one.

text_blocks.speaker: Telfair
text_blocks.text: Do you have your 'the block', your favorite block in your basketball career?

text_blocks.speaker: Amen Thompson
text_blocks.text: My favorite block in my basketball career, I had a game-winning block against Utah. I blocked KD from behind when he was on the Suns. I'll probably say the KD block just because he's on my team now. I don't think I've ever blocked LeBron. I gotta do that this year. I don't have a block like LeBron's championship one block, but I have a lot of blocks. I block a lot of jump shots. Oh, I block Curry badly once in In-Season Tournament. That was a good one.
